prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices", "Signing in links your desktop companion to your account so progress, custom traits, and adoption data are never lost.", "Continue to Sign In", "Cloud Backup Enabled", "Your companion will follow you whenever you switch devices or reinstall."]
1: ["Summoning Your Desktop Companion", "We are preparing your pet's animations, desktop overlay permissions, and interactive behaviors.", "Building pet companion model...", "Configuring desktop window transparency"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Personality", "Select how active and interactive you want your desktop companion to be throughout your workday.", "Confirm Companion Traits", "Playful Explorer, Calm Desk Buddy, Focus Helper"]
3: []
4: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to open quick actions or send them to sleep.", "Drag and drop your companion anywhere on your screen once generation completes."]
5: ["Use bright, single-subject photos with clear lighting for the best pet generation accuracy.", "Recommended: High Resolution & Frontal View"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Here are the quick gestures to interact with your pet at any time.", "Click to pet, Right-click for options, Drag to reposition"]
7: ["Pick Your First Companion's Path", "Don't worry—you can adopt additional pets or change your companion settings anytime from the desktop menu.", "Selecting a path unlocks your initial companion style."]
8: ["Give your desktop companion a name", "Official Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Play completion sound when pet arrives"]
